name: Kapoly (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of blue and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kapoly (a blue shield with a fleur-de-lis and a green mound, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll inscribed KAPOLY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kapoly arms with wreath and scroll
